subject: EVGO Morocco operator attribution

evidence.fact: The EVGO application developer/trader is identified as NAREVA SERVICES; support uses evgo.ma and nareva.ma addresses.
The EVGO application provider is identified as Nareva Services, Casablanca, Morocco.

attribution.reason: Official app stores prove who supplies the native EVGO application and service brand, but do not by themselves prove that Nareva Services is the OCPI/OCPP CPO for every station displayed in the app. Station-level operator evidence remains required before assigning cpo/operator in the production dataset.

modeling_rule: Keep app_provider, network_brand, CPO/operator, site_brand, tariff_channel and status_source separate until station-level API or equivalent operator evidence confirms the CPO.
